001package pkg_engine;
002
003import java.awt.BorderLayout;
004import java.awt.Color;
005import java.awt.Dimension;
006import java.awt.Font;
007
008import javax.swing.BorderFactory;
009import javax.swing.JFrame;
010import javax.swing.JLabel;
011import javax.swing.JPanel;
012import javax.swing.JProgressBar;
013
014/**
015 * A splash screen displayed while the {@link AssetManager} downloads missing game assets from the
016 * remote server.
017 *
018 * <p>Shows a progress bar with a status label indicating which file is being downloaded and how
019 * many remain. When all downloads complete (or fail after retries), the screen closes automatically
020 * and the game starts.
021 *
022 * @author Barnabe Jouanard
023 * @version 2026.04.17
024 */
025public class LoadingScreen {
026    /** The loading window frame. */
027    private JFrame aFrame;
028
029    /** Progress bar tracking download completion. */
030    private JProgressBar aProgressBar;
031
032    /** Label showing the name of the file currently being downloaded. */
033    private JLabel aStatusLabel;
034
035    /** Label showing the overall download count (e.g. "3 / 19"). */
036    private JLabel aCountLabel;
037
038    /** Reference to the asset manager performing the downloads. */
039    private AssetManager aAssetManager;
040
041    /**
042     * Creates a new loading screen linked to the given asset manager.
043     *
044     * @param pAssetManager the asset manager that will perform the downloads
045     */
046    public LoadingScreen(final AssetManager pAssetManager) {
047        this.aAssetManager = pAssetManager;
048        this.createGUI();
049    } // LoadingScreen()
050
051    /** Builds the loading screen UI: title, progress bar, and status labels. */
052    private void createGUI() {
053        this.aFrame = new JFrame("Pokémon Delta Emerald — Loading");
054        this.aFrame.setDefaultCloseOperation(JFrame.EXIT_ON_CLOSE);
055        this.aFrame.setResizable(false);
056
057        JPanel vPanel = new JPanel();
058        vPanel.setLayout(new BorderLayout(10, 10));
059        vPanel.setBorder(BorderFactory.createEmptyBorder(30, 40, 30, 40));
060        vPanel.setBackground(new Color(30, 30, 40));
061
062        // Title
063        JLabel vTitle = new JLabel("Pokémon Delta Emerald", JLabel.CENTER);
064        vTitle.setFont(new Font("SansSerif", Font.BOLD, 50));
065        vTitle.setForeground(new Color(255, 215, 0));
066
067        // Progress bar
068        this.aProgressBar = new JProgressBar(0, 100);
069        this.aProgressBar.setStringPainted(true);
070        this.aProgressBar.setPreferredSize(new Dimension(400, 30));
071        this.aProgressBar.setForeground(new Color(76, 175, 80));
072        this.aProgressBar.setBackground(new Color(50, 50, 60));
073
074        // Status label
075        this.aStatusLabel = new JLabel("Checking assets...", JLabel.CENTER);
076        this.aStatusLabel.setFont(new Font("SansSerif", Font.PLAIN, 14));
077        this.aStatusLabel.setForeground(new Color(200, 200, 210));
078
079        // Count label
080        this.aCountLabel = new JLabel(" ", JLabel.CENTER);
081        this.aCountLabel.setFont(new Font("SansSerif", Font.PLAIN, 13));
082        this.aCountLabel.setForeground(new Color(160, 160, 170));
083
084        // Layout: south panel for labels
085        JPanel vSouthPanel = new JPanel();
086        vSouthPanel.setLayout(new BorderLayout(5, 5));
087        vSouthPanel.setOpaque(false);
088        vSouthPanel.add(this.aStatusLabel, BorderLayout.NORTH);
089        vSouthPanel.add(this.aCountLabel, BorderLayout.SOUTH);
090
091        vPanel.add(vTitle, BorderLayout.NORTH);
092        vPanel.add(this.aProgressBar, BorderLayout.CENTER);
093        vPanel.add(vSouthPanel, BorderLayout.SOUTH);
094
095        this.aFrame.getContentPane().add(vPanel);
096        this.aFrame.pack();
097        this.aFrame.setLocationRelativeTo(null);
098    } // createGUI()
099
100    /** Refreshes the visible progress bar from the asset manager counters. */
101    public void setProgressBar() {
102        int vProgress = (int) (((double) this.aAssetManager.getCurrentProgress() / this.aAssetManager.getTotalAssets()) * 100);
103        this.aProgressBar.setValue(vProgress);
104    } // setProgressBar()
105
106    /**
107     * Shows the loading screen. This method blocks until the download finishes (success or offline
108     * fallback).
109     */
110    public void startAndWait() {
111        this.aFrame.setVisible(true);
112        this.aAssetManager.downloadAssets();
113        while (this.aAssetManager.isComplete() == false) {} // startAndWait()
114
115        if (this.aAssetManager.getErrorMessage() != null) {
116            this.aStatusLabel.setText(this.aAssetManager.getErrorMessage());
117            this.aCountLabel.setText("Starting in offline mode...");
118            try {
119                Thread.sleep(3000);
120            } catch (InterruptedException ignore) {
121            }
122            this.aFrame.setVisible(false);
123            this.aFrame.dispose();
124            return;
125        }
126        this.aProgressBar.setValue(100);
127        this.aStatusLabel.setText("All assets downloaded! Starting game...");
128        try {
129            Thread.sleep(2000);
130        } catch (InterruptedException ignore) {
131        }
132        this.aFrame.setVisible(false);
133        this.aFrame.dispose();
134    } // startAndWait()
135} // LoadingScreen
